title: Regulatory Assessment of Allianz Insurance's Planned Acquisition of Income Insurance
what_it_is: Regulatory Assessment of Allianz Insurance's Planned Acquisition of Income Insurance

sections.label: MAS scrutiny of Allianz Income acquisition
sections.summary: Questions ask whether MAS will scrutinise the Allianz purchase of 51% of Income Insurance and consider Income's social mission.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (a) whether MAS will be working with the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore to scrutinise the planned purchase by Allianz Insurance of a 51% stake in Income Insurance Ltd; and (b) whether MAS will take into consideration of the ability for Income Insurance Ltd to continue fulfilling the social mission of providing affordable insurance plans to Singaporeans after the acquisition by Allianz Insurance as one of criteria for approving the acquisition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (a) whether MAS is aware of the key considerations behind the planned acquisition of Income Insurance Ltd by Allianz Insurance; (b) if so, what are they; (c) what is MAS’ assessment of the impact of the acquisition on (i) the availability of existing and future insurance products that were designed for social good and (ii) the options available to Singaporean consumers and SMEs; and (d) whether MAS is aware if Income Insurance Ltd’s mission as a social enterprise will be preserved post-acquisition.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance (a) what is MAS’ assessment of the impact of the planned acquisition of Income Insurance Ltd by Allianz Insurance on the social mission of Income Insurance Ltd in providing affordable and well-structured insurance products for Singaporeans; and (b) what avenues and measures are available for Income Insurance Ltd policyholders to allay their concerns about the balance of interests shifting in favour of the new potential shareholder.

sections.label: MAS criteria for shareholder approval
sections.summary: MAS says it considers criteria including the applicant's track record, financial soundness, reputation, and fitness and propriety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: When MAS assesses the application for a change in substantial shareholder in an insurer, we will consider a range of criteria, in particular, the applicant's track record, financial soundness, reputation, as well as fitness and propriety.

sections.label: MAS satisfied with conflict processes
sections.summary: MAS reviewed and was satisfied with Income's board processes addressing conflicts of interest over its financial advisor and the Allianz deal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: With regard to Mr de Souza's question on the management of conflicts of interest, MAS had reviewed and was satisfied with the relevant processes Income's board had put in place to address conflicts of interest with respect to the appointment of its financial advisor on this proposed deal and the decision to enter into the deal with Allianz.

sections.label: No competition concern from deal
sections.summary: Allianz Insurance Singapore is ranked 14th in general insurance with 2% market share, and there is no significant overlap with Income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Allianz Insurance Singapore Pte Ltd is ranked 14th in general insurance with a market share of 2% based on written premiums.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: There is no significant overlap between Income and Allianz's overall insurance business in Singapore and hence, there is no concern about adverse impact of the proposed deal on competition in the sector.

sections.label: Existing insurance contract terms unchanged
sections.summary: If the proposed deal is approved, there will be no change to the terms and conditions of existing insurance contracts.

sentences.text: Should the proposed deal be approved, there will be no change to the terms and conditions of existing insurance contracts.

sections.label: MAS holds firms to commitments
sections.summary: MAS will hold Income and Allianz to their commitments and restricts profit allocation and expenses charged to participating funds.

sentences.text: MAS will hold Income and Allianz to account to these commitments.

For participating policies where policyholders share in the profits of the participating fund, MAS protects the interests of policyholders by restricting the ratio of profits allocated to shareholders and the type of expenses insurers may charge to the participating fund.

sections.label: Allianz US case and Income
sections.summary: Allianz settled a US criminal case for around US$6 billion, while Income serves 1.7 million Singaporeans with significant market share.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: First, I know that Allianz settled a criminal case in the United States (US) two years ago for around US$6 billion over allegations that it defrauded investors, and its US subsidiary pleaded guilty to criminal securities fraud and agreed to pay fines and make restitution to investors.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Because after all Income serves 1.7 million Singaporeans with a significant market share in areas such as motor insurance, about 20%, in property and also health, roughly around 15% for each of those.

sections.label: Structured Alpha funds and Singapore entity
sections.summary: The Singapore Allianz entity did not manage or offer the Structured Alpha funds that got into trouble with US regulators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The product that got into trouble with the US regulators, the Allianz entity that is in Singapore, they did not manage and they also did not offer similar funds, like this fund that got into trouble, which is called the Structured Alpha funds.

sections.label: Fair treatment of workers
sections.summary: The expectation is that Income and Allianz treat workers fairly and comply fully with MOM employment laws and guidelines.

sentences.text: The assurance I want to give to the Member and also to our workers is that we expect Income and Allianz, we expect the entity to treat its workers fairly and to comply fully with the MOM employment laws and guidelines.

sections.label: Rule of law in insurance
sections.summary: Rules and regulations must be implemented and regulator decisions taken transparently and lawfully, with even-handedness and a level playing field.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: In order for us to promote a competitive and vibrant insurance sector, we need to make sure that our rules and regulations for the financial sector, for the insurance sector, are being implemented and that the regulator's decisions are being taken with transparency and also in accordance with what the law provides.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: This is what we mean by rule of law – that it is not one set of treatment for one entity and another set of treatment for another entity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We have to have even-handedness and a level playing field across different entities within the market so that we are able to promote more competition in a more vibrant, in a more competitive market, which ultimately will serve the interests of our policyholders.

sections.label: MAS on existing policy terms
sections.summary: MAS will make sure the terms and conditions of existing policies will not change after the proposed deal has gone through.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For MAS, my reply earlier to Ms Foo, to Mr Ang and others, and also in my main reply, that is what MAS will focus on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We will make sure that the terms and conditions of the existing policies will not change after the proposed deal has gone through.

sections.label: Letters from Tan Suee Chieh
sections.summary: Two letters from Mr Tan Suee Chieh have been noted, and further work will establish the facts before assessing position and next steps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: To Mr Singh's second question, we have noted the two letters from Mr Tan Suee Chieh.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We will do some further work to establish what the facts are before we assess what our position is and our next steps.

sections.label: Insurance products and Income
sections.summary: Providing insurance products for different segments, including vulnerable ones, is not only Income's purview, and NTUC and NTUC Enterprise share Ms Phua's view.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The provision of these different insurance products that cater to different segments of the society, including the vulnerable segments that Mr Singh mentioned, today, it is not just the purview of Income.
If I may now turn to Ms Denise Phua's question, Ms Phua's starting point is a correct one, and that is also the view of NTUC and NTUC Enterprise.

sections.label: NTUC social mission objectives
sections.summary: NTUC and NTUC Enterprise want to fulfil their social mission, and see this deal as a better, more effective way to do good with a strong Income.

sentences.text: For this particular proposed deal, one of the key objectives that NTUC and NTUC Enterprise want to achieve is exactly that.
They continue to want to fulfil their social mission.
But this is a better way of fulfilling that social mission and this is a more effective way for them to do good if they are able to have a strong Income.
